constraints: v1.0 reuses v0.9 exact presentation rebuild for every submitted declared-set package.
A two-to-sixty-four member caller roster canonicalizes unique member labels and unique expected v0.9 presentation references into an exact digest.
Every caller-declared member label is bound to one exact expected v0.9 presentation id, schema, and digest without authenticating the label.
A roster member with no submitted exact package is listed as missing and causes an incomplete-coverage hold without claiming intentional withholding.
A valid exact presentation whose reference differs from the declared commitment is retained as a mismatch and excluded from the matching pair set.
Every unordered pair of matching commitments is reconciled through v0.9; sixty-four matching submissions produce exactly 2,016 pair references.
Any v0.9 contradiction among matching declared presentations produces a typed declared-set hold with exact pair count and classification.
Complete declared commitment coverage with no co-presented contradiction is classified as pairwise compatible without global consistency or adoption authority.
An independently valid unlisted presentation exact-rebuilds while its digest is absent from a complete declared-set receipt; unlisted roots remain explicitly unexcluded.

Receipts retain member labels, bounded references, pair classifications, counts, and truth flags; no transient packages, raw keys, signatures, private context, model output, or machine paths are embedded.
Rosters are limited to 64 members and 128 KiB; assessments are limited to 64 submissions, 2,016 pairs, and 32 MiB canonical UTF-8 input.
Roster, every submission, every matching pair, decision, content, and digest rebuild deterministically from the complete caller package.
A fresh Node process rebuilds and verifies the serialized roster and all-pairs assessment with the same digest and classification.
